recognize_zh: 同一張骨髓切片中，骨小樑左側仍是正常造血骨髓，右側則被纖維增生（desmoplastic）間質取代，內有黏聚成巢、細胞質嗜酸性、核大且有核仁的上皮細胞，這種「異物般成巢的黏聚細胞」即轉移性癌的線索。
features: Sharp contrast between residual normocellular trilineage hematopoietic marrow (left) and a tumor-replaced intertrabecular space (right)
Cohesive nests and anastomosing cords of large polygonal epithelial cells with moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Enlarged pleomorphic vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli
Surrounding desmoplastic/fibrotic stroma with loss of fat and hematopoietic elements
Intervening bone trabecula without significant osteoblastic rimming in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula separating residual hematopoietic marrow with trilineage elements from an intertrabecular space extensively replaced by desmoplastic stroma. Within the stroma are cohesive nests and cords of large polygonal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, pleomorphic vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, foreign to the marrow. Definite keratin pearls are not evident in this field. In a patient with known squamous cell carcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with squamous cell carcinoma; confirmation with p40/p63 and cytokeratin immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Adenocarcinoma forms glands or shows mucin vacuoles and is typically CK7/TTF-1/CDX2 positive, whereas squamous carcinoma forms solid nests with dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, keratinization and p40/p63 positivity.
Megakaryocytes are single large lobulated cells and osteoblasts line trabeculae with eccentric nuclei and a hof, unlike cohesive nests of atypical epithelial cells in desmoplastic stroma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid tumors infiltrate as discohesive sheets without desmoplastic nests and are cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic melanoma or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Melanoma is S100/SOX10 positive and small round cell tumors have scant cytoplasm, unlike keratin-positive polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm.
